name: 4-thioisomescaline
summary: 4-Thioisomescaline (4-TIM), also known as 2,3-dimethoxy-4-methylthiophenethylamine, is a chemical compound of the phenethylamine and scaline families related to mescaline. It is the analogue of isomescaline in which the methoxy group at the 4 position has been replaced with a methylthio group.

fact.en: Isomescaline has the same three methoxy groups as mescaline but in a different arrangement on the ring, and it is far weaker. 4-Thioisomescaline then swaps one of those oxygens for sulphur.
fact.zh: 異麥司卡林（isomescaline）和麥司卡林一樣有三個甲氧基，只是在環上的排列不同，效力也弱得多。4-硫代異麥司卡林則再把其中一個氧換成硫。
fact.zhHans: 异麦司卡林（isomescaline）和麦司卡林一样有三个甲氧基，只是在环上的排列不同，效力也弱得多。4-硫代异麦司卡林则再把其中一个氧换成硫。
